steps.title: Check official sources for new laws and rules on a topic
Extract each new rule's clauses, dates, definitions and duties
Write a plain-language summary that cites a clause for every point
Decide whether the reviewed summary is delivered (a person)

value.summary: A collection of nouns and verbs for watching official public sources for new laws and rules on a topic: reading them only through permitted official access, extracting their clauses, writing a summary that cites a clause for every point and is marked not legal advice, having a different worker review every citation, and delivering it only when a person decides.
value.title: Policy and law watch

steps.title: Find the official budget document and read its terms
Extract one program area's line items with pages and lines
Write a cited report on the program area's budget
Review every figure in the report (a different worker)
Decide whether the reviewed report is delivered (a person)

value.summary: A collection of nouns and verbs for reporting on a public state or city budget: finding the official budget document through permitted access, extracting one program area's line items with their pages and lines, writing a report that cites every figure, having a different worker review it, and delivering it only when a person decides.
value.title: Public budget report
